title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - EA-5601
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: EA-5601 (SOLVENT HEATER).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-5601, Title: P&ID: SOLVENT HEATER EA-5601.
Area: 5600 – Solvent Recovery System, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-5600-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- TIC-5602: Outlet Temperature Controller (Temp Controller) [Setpoint: SP 95 °C]. Function: Control Loop C1, EFF-1 (Modulate Steam Valve). Location: Hot hexane out line. Interlock: C1/EFF-1
- TT-5602: Outlet Temperature Transmitter (Temp Transmitter). Function: Senses hexane temp for TIC-5602. Location: Hot hexane out line. Interlock: —
- TV-5602: Steam Control Valve (Control Valve) [Setpoint: Air-actuated —]. Function: Modulated by TIC-5602 (EFF-1). Location: MP steam in line. Interlock: EFF-1
- TCV-5602: Temp Control Valve Actuator Signal (Signal / Actuator). Function: Actuator control signal for TV-5602. Location: MP steam in line. Interlock: —
- PDAH-5605: Tube-side Fouling Alarm (dP Alarm) [Setpoint: > 0.7 bar]. Function: Cause A1 / EFF-2 Alarm (Fouling). Location: Solvent across exchanger. Interlock: A1/EFF-2
- PDT-5605: Tube-side Diff Pressure Transmitter (dP Transmitter). Function: Sends dP signal to PDAH-5605. Location: Solvent across exchanger. Interlock: —
- PT-5605: Outlet Pressure Transmitter (Pressure Transmitter). Function: Pressure Monitoring. Location: Hot hexane out line. Interlock: —
- PSV-5607: Tube-side Relief Valve (Pressure Safety Valve) [Setpoint: 16 barg]. Function: Mechanical Relief (R1 / EFF-3). Location: Hot hexane out line. Interlock: R1/EFF-3
- TI-5604: Condensate Temperature Indicator (Temp Indicator). Function: Permissive P2 / Local indication. Location: Condensate Out line. Interlock: P2
- TT-5604: Condensate Temperature Transmitter (Temp Transmitter). Function: Condensate Temperature Monitoring. Location: Condensate Out line. Interlock: —
- ST-5604: Steam Trap Assembly (Steam Trap). Function: Drains condensate. Location: Condensate Out line. Interlock: —
- FT-5603: Steam Flow Transmitter (Flow Transmitter). Function: Steam Flow Measurement. Location: MP steam in line. Interlock: —
- FI-5603: Steam Flow Indicator (Flow Indicator). Function: Local/DCS Flow Indication. Location: MP steam in line. Interlock: —
- FI-5601: Hexane Flow Indicator (Flow Indicator). Function: Local/DCS Flow Indication. Location: Cold hexane in line. Interlock: —
- FSL upstream: Solvent Flow Switch (dari GA-5610) (Flow Switch). Function: Permissive P1 (Flow Established). Location: Cold hexane in line. Interlock: P1
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-EA-5601, Interlock: N/A (control loop only).
